proposal_fate: five mutually exclusive final fates; accepted means committed before cap/EOG; first mismatch and unexamined separated
draft_continuation: actual proposal decode plus sync/catch-up calls and rows; draft UB1
target_physical_work: actual successful process_ubatch calls in llama_context::decode and actual ubatch.n_tokens; not logical k+1 concurrency
rollback_calls: one reconciled speculative cycle; kv_trim_calls retains both target/draft trim calls
width_hist: actual occupied query rows from native ubatch execution; no GPU completion time inferred
observation: baseline disables new work counters; counts integer summaries only; lite enqueue/sample timestamps without added sync; heavy explicit sync/full KV state and periodic memory/readbacks/cycles; compute callbacks disabled in all modes, ETW unavailable
memory: counts/lite/baseline native load/pre-request/request begin/prefill/phase/end checkpoints; heavy retains5ms and per-decode observations; minima are sampled/checkpoint scope, never continuous residency
timing: Whole request always includes mandatory checks, control, synchronization and pipe endpoint parsing. Per-decode added observer sync removed outside heavy; original reset/final lifecycle and native sampler logits waits preserved.
mode_switch: request-level mode switch before reset, same worker/context per profile arm; formal adapter forces counts
